_about: Set 3 layouts: the hero lockup of the Palmonas '9KT Pendant Free' card, at the bottom on the black camisole: the wordmark, the offer in a large upright serif, a sans qualifier that makes it true, the piece and its price on one tracked line, and the chip. Every claim is the storefront's own: 'Applied in your bag, no code' (the PDP offer box), free insured shipping and insured delivery in 3-5 working days (product page and footer), every piece in the Naira gift box (NairaBoxShowcase), cash on delivery on serviceable pincodes (product page). Prices are the live Shopify prices on 4 Nov 2026.
